source: Ed4 B.7.2.1 Step 2 (c) and Step 3, p.B-28; C.7.2 (p), p.C-100
description: A PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST from the Caller after its ARQ data has arrived on the link breaks the Called node's link locally and is accepted as a new link with fresh ARQ state.
note: As cas/make-repeat-request-answered up to 57550: 0.0.1.3 calls, this node accepts and the link is made with this node as the Called node (B-0213, B-0400, C-1100), cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 and the called node's soft link timers start (B-0215, A-0194, A-0197). At 61000 the Caller sends DATA-ONLY FSN 0 with "aaaa" (DELIVER IN ORDER, TX WIN LWE, EOT 20): delivered at once, nothing being missing before it (C-0178), cas.first_data stops (B-0215, B-0403), the idle wait restarts, and RX LWE becomes 1. The burst ends at 62000 with the EOT end at 71000: csma.vdcd_end 9000, LBT rule 1, contention 12000 ms, and at 83000 our ACK-ONLY (RX LWE 1, no bitmap). At 101000 0.0.1.3 sends a PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST again (Ed4 set, octet 12, its C_PDU ID 1). Its ARQ data has arrived on this link, so it heard our accept, and this cannot be a repeat of the request we answered: the Caller no longer holds the link and starts afresh (B-0452; B-0214 answers a repeat only while no ARQ D_PDU from the Caller has arrived). Our link is broken locally (as B-0324): link_state unlinked, D_CONNECTION_TERMINATED to the DTS (nothing of ours is unfinished, so nothing is rejected, C-0652, C-0866) and C_PHYSICAL_LINK_BROKEN to the SIS, which stops its soft link timers (A-0199). The request is then handled as a new one and PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED is queued (Ed4 echoed, B-0138). The burst ends at 102000: csma.vdcd_end 4000, LBT rule 1, contention 45000 ms; at 151000 the accept goes out with our C_PDU ID 1, and when that transmission ends at 156550 the link is made again as the Called node: link_state linked, D_CONNECTION_MADE with fresh window edges (C-0571, C-0782), cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 and the soft link timers. At 161000 the Caller, also starting afresh, sends DATA-ONLY FSN 0 with "dddd". With the old RX LWE of 1 it would be a copy behind RX LWE, acknowledged and not delivered (C-1126); on the new link it is new data, delivered, and cas.first_data stops. Burst end 162000, csma.vdcd_end 9000, contention 36000 ms, and at 207000 the ACK-ONLY, RX LWE 1. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080). dts.ack_wait_ms 60000. Settings: cas.max_links, cas.link_request_timeout_ms 60000, cas.link_request_retries and cas.first_data_timeout_ms 120000. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133). A CAS-1 C_PDU of one octet in a type 8 D_PDU fills a block exactly, C_PDU IDs from 0 in each node's own sequence (C-1040), EOW 0. The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived from the answer wait (A-0321). Since corpus 0.28.0 (P7-3), every D_PDU this node sends to a peer recorded Ed4 carries EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY (Ed4 1, Duplex 0), where it carried EMPTY (C-0426, C-1260); an owed UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR still goes first (C-1079), and D_PDUs to a peer of unknown edition, a peer recorded Ed3 or a group carry EMPTY as before. Where this note says EOW 0 or EMPTY for such a D_PDU, read CAPABILITY. Only EOW and header CRC bytes changed.
